rows.scope: Declared attributes evaluated (expression in Path) and NameSpace defaulted; only declared properties written on update, so a removed attribute keeps its value; update runs on Activate/Configure, not compile -only; invalid value fails the load with nothing kept. Native w1-w3, c1-c2, f1. IRIS Security.Applications validation, name normalization and default Timeout are providers.

A second module declaring the same name in different case is refused as a duplicate (n1); trailing slash names one application (t1); uninstall deletes the owner's application (u1). Renamed applications across versions are C:D26 and not re-tested.
